column1: # Symbol typeface code -> Unicode character (the character that stands in for the glyph where the typeface is not installed).
# Columns: typeface, code (hex, 0x20..0xFF; Word writes it as U+F000 + code in the private use area), Unicode (hex), the glyph's name.
# The Symbol typeface is not here: it is Adobe's Symbol encoding, adobe-symbol.txt (Unicode, Inc.).
# Written by ibisOffice for the glyphs of Wingdings, Wingdings 2 and Wingdings 3 whose shape has a Unicode character (the glyph names
# are those of the typeface; the shapes were compared by eye). Glyphs with no such character (faces, hands, clocks...) are not listed.
